g.text: Speed of Light analysis of Monte Carlo rerandomization
RTX 5080 Laptop GPU · 4,096 units · 2,048 covariates · batch 4,096 · 0.1% accepted · FP32 HIGHEST.
Roofline estimate uses the listed 2,287 MHz upper boost clock; hardware counters were unavailable.
Timings were measured separately. The complete R call includes the JAX GPU stage; R uses the system reference BLAS.
